inputs.description: 4 sample posts measured against the codex

summary.headline: One post has already drifted all the way to generic LLM-voice — rewrite it toward your codex before an AI learns to produce more of it.
summary.narrative: Measured against the brand codex, the post 'Leveraging Synergies to Unlock Holistic Growth' is interchangeable filler: it carries banned language, drops every signature element, and names no concrete deliverable. It is the pattern an AI will multiply if left as a positive example. Rewrite it toward the codex voice and add it to the watch-list.

findings.title: 'Leveraging Synergies' post has drifted to generic LLM-voice
findings.what_we_found: Measured against the codex, the post 'Leveraging Synergies to Unlock Holistic Growth' reads as interchangeable LLM filler — abstract, stakeholder-facing, with no point of view and none of the brand's signature voice.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: If this stays live as an unflagged example, an AI generating from the corpus will treat the mean as the target and multiply bland, undifferentiated copy at scale.
the_fix: Rewrite toward the codex voice: restore the summit/climb metaphor and the we→you address.
Anchor the piece to a concrete deliverable (a defined lifecycle, a governed glossary, an enablement plan).
Add the post to a distinctiveness watch-list and re-check after rewrite.
findings.evidence: "In today's fast-paced digital landscape, organizations must leverage cutting-edge solutions to unlock holistic, end-to-end synergies."

findings.title: Codex banned-language phrases present verbatim
findings.what_we_found: The same post contains four phrases on the codex banned_language list: 'leverage synergies', 'in today's fast-paced landscape', 'holistic, end-to-end', and 'robust, scalable' used as filler.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: Banned filler in a live post sets a precedent an AI will replicate; the codex exists precisely to keep these phrases out of market-facing copy.
the_fix: Replace each banned phrase with codex approved_language ('harmonize', 'with intention', 'governed glossary').
Wire the banned-language list into the pre-publication check so these phrases are caught before any draft ships.
findings.evidence: Phrases 'leverage synergies', 'in today's fast-paced landscape', 'holistic, end-to-end', 'robust, scalable' all match codex banned_language.

findings.title: No signature elements or concrete deliverable
findings.what_we_found: The post drops every codex signature element — no summit metaphor, no we→you address — and names no concrete deliverable, staying purely aspirational.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: The codex requires every promise to land on a concrete deliverable; a piece with none teaches an AI that vague aspiration is acceptable brand output.
the_fix: Reintroduce the signature metaphor and direct we→you address.
Tie the central promise to one concrete deliverable so the piece earns its place against the codex.
findings.evidence: No summit metaphor, no we/you address, no deliverable named in the body.
